label: v160
changes: On a calendar that isn't Google? Apple, Outlook and the rest can all export a .ics file — bring one in and the appointments land on the right people, repeat events and cancellations included. You can save yours out as a file too.
Google Calendar should stop asking you to reconnect. It now quietly renews permission in the background instead of sending you through the consent screen every time you open the app.

The star sign card now shows real Sun, Moon and Rising signs, worked out from the actual positions of the sun and moon rather than a rough date table. Where a birth time or place is missing it says so plainly instead of guessing.
Add a birth time and it can tell you the moon sign; add the time zone and rough coordinates and it can tell you the rising sign too.
The 'describe your own style' box on fun avatars is now checked before anything reaches the image generator.
